answer_1.quote: We evaluate our model on two benchmark datasets for multi-turn dialogue generation, including DailyDialog and ConvAI2 ... our model is able to yield better dialogue responses than four strong baselines

answer_2.quote: We choose three commonly used reference-based metrics including BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE ... We also use Distinct to evaluate the lexical diversity with Distinct-1 and Distinct-2

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 300 examples from the test sets of DailyDialog and ConvAI2 respectively, and recruit 6 well-educated native speakers to do qualitative analysis on the responses generated by our model and all competitive baselines ... The annotators judge the quality of the responses from four aspects: Fluency, Relevance, Informativeness, Engagement.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator assigns a score from {0,1,2} representing 'bad', 'fair', 'good' for each response on each aspect; agreement measured via Fleiss' kappa.
